seo.description: Werdhe is one of the first digital real-estate platforms of its kind in Guinea. Discover our mission, our values and our team.

apropos.heroDesc: Werdhe connects landlords and tenants directly, with no middleman, using modern digital tools built for the Guinean market.

mission.para1: In Guinea, finding a home or a reliable tenant is often an uphill battle - exorbitant agency fees, lack of transparency, and paperwork that's hard to manage.
mission.para2: Werdhe changes that. By putting technology to work for Guineans, we simplify every step: from the search to signing the lease, through to tracking payments.

valeurs.desc: No hidden fees, no middleman. The price you see is the price you pay.
Verified files, official leases, mutual ratings. Trust is built together.
The tenant space is 100% free. Werdhe is built for every Guinean.
Guinea's first digital real-estate platform, designed mobile-first.

cta.desc: Whether you're a landlord or a tenant, Werdhe is built for you. Create your account for free.

seo.description: Contact the Werdhe team or check our FAQ. We reply within 24 hours.

contact.sousTitre: Check the FAQ or contact our team

questions.r: Yes, the tenant space is 100% free and always will be. No agency fees, no commission - you only pay your rent directly to the landlord.

questions.q: How do I apply for a property?
questions.r: Find a listing, click "Apply", fill out the form with your desired move-in date and lease length. The landlord receives your application and may ask for a complete file (ID, proof of employment, etc.).

questions.q: What documents do I need to prepare?
questions.r: Generally: a form of ID, proof of income or employment, and optionally a guarantor's contact details. Some landlords may ask for pay slips.

questions.q: How do I sign the lease online?
questions.r: Once your application is accepted and the deposit paid, the landlord generates the lease. You get a notification and can sign electronically from your "My Applications" space.

questions.q: How do I track the status of my application?
questions.r: In your dashboard, under "My Applications", you see the real-time status of each application: pending, file requested, under review, accepted, etc.

questions.q: What if the landlord doesn't respond?
questions.r: If you haven't heard back after 48 hours, you can use the built-in messaging to follow up directly with the landlord. If the issue persists, contact our support.

questions.q: How much does Werdhe cost for landlords?
questions.r: The Free plan lets you manage up to 2 properties. The Pro plan (120,000 GNF/month) allows up to 25 properties with advanced features. The Agency plan (300,000 GNF/month) offers unlimited properties. 14-day free Pro trial, no commitment.

questions.q: How do I publish my first property?
questions.r: In your dashboard, click "+ Add a property", fill in the details (title, address, price, size) and add photos. Your listing is published immediately.

questions.q: How does the Werdhe commission work?
questions.r: Werdhe takes a 5% commission on every rent payment collected through the platform. This commission is calculated automatically. It covers all our services: document generation, alerts, messaging, etc.

Yes. With the Pro plan, manage up to 25 properties. The Agency plan offers unlimited properties with multi-user management. From your dashboard, each property has its own record with its tenants and payments.

questions.q: How do I generate a rent receipt?
questions.r: In the "Documents" tab, select the property and tenant, choose "Rent receipt" and click "Generate". The receipt is created as a PDF and automatically emailed to the tenant.

questions.q: What happens if a tenant doesn't pay?
questions.r: The system automatically sends an alert at day 3 and a formal notice at day 5. You receive a notification and an email. Official letter templates are available in the Documents section.
Orange Money, MTN MoMo, cash and bank transfer (BICIGUI, Ecobank). Mobile Money payments are available from the Pro plan onward.

Yes, from Settings > Delete my account. Your personal data is deleted within 30 days, subject to legal retention obligations.
No, never. Werdhe does not sell your data to third parties for commercial purposes. The only sharing is with our technical providers (hosting, payments) strictly within the scope of our services.

seo.description: Terms of use for the Werdhe platform — Rental housing in Guinea.

cgu.intro: Please read these terms carefully before using the Werdhe platform. By signing up, you accept these terms in full.
cgu.questionsContact: Questions about our terms of use?

1.contenu:
Werdhe is a digital platform for rental management and matchmaking, published by QbelyTech, headquartered in Guinea. The platform is available at https://werdhe.com.

Werdhe allows landlords to publish and manage their properties, and tenants to search for a home, submit applications and track their rental online.

2.contenu:
Using the Werdhe platform implies full and unconditional acceptance of these Terms of Use. If you do not accept these terms, please stop using our services immediately.

These terms may be changed at any time. Users will be notified of any significant change by email or via a notification on the platform.

3.contenu:
To use Werdhe's services, you must create an account by providing accurate, complete and up-to-date information. You are responsible for keeping your login credentials confidential.

Werdhe reserves the right to suspend or delete any account in the event of:
• Providing false or misleading information
• Fraudulent or abusive behavior
• Failure to comply with these Terms of Use
• A request from competent authorities

4.contenu:
Werdhe offers the following services:

For landlords: publishing properties, managing applications, generating documents (leases, receipts), payment tracking, automatic alerts.

For tenants: searching for housing, submitting applications, electronic lease signing, tracking payments and the rental.

The tenant space is entirely free. Landlords may subscribe to paid plans to access advanced features.

5.contenu:
Landlords agree to:
• Only publish properties they legally own or are authorized to manage
• Provide accurate information about their properties (size, price, condition)
• Comply with applicable rental regulations in Guinea
• Respond to applications within a reasonable time
• Not discriminate when selecting tenants
• Pay the commissions owed to Werdhe (5% of each rent payment collected)

6.contenu:
Tenants agree to:
• Provide authentic documents when submitting their application
• Comply with the terms of the signed lease
• Pay their rent on the agreed dates
• Keep the property in good condition
• Report any issue to the landlord as soon as possible

7.contenu:
Werdhe charges a 5% commission on every rent payment collected by landlords using the platform. This commission is calculated automatically when payments are recorded.

Subscription plans (Pro: 120,000 GNF/month, Agency: 300,000 GNF/month) are billed monthly. Failure to pay results in the suspension of premium features.

Werdhe uses third-party payment providers (Orange Money, MTN MoMo) and does not store any banking information on its servers.

8.contenu:
Documents generated by Werdhe (leases, receipts, inventory reports) have contractual value between the parties. Electronic signatures made on the platform are recognized as valid by the parties.

Werdhe cannot be held liable for disputes arising from contracts signed via the platform. It is up to the parties to review the content of documents before signing.

9.contenu:
Werdhe acts as an intermediary between landlords and tenants and cannot be held liable for:
• The quality or actual condition of listed properties
• The accuracy of information provided by users
• Disputes between landlords and tenants
• Payment issues between parties

Werdhe strives to keep the platform available 24/7, but cannot guarantee uninterrupted availability.

10.contenu:
All elements making up the Werdhe platform (logo, design, code, text, images) are protected by intellectual property rights. Any reproduction, even partial, is prohibited without QbelyTech's written permission.

Users retain ownership of the content they publish on the platform (property photos, documents) and grant Werdhe a non-exclusive license to display it on the platform.

11.contenu:
Any user may delete their account at any time from their profile settings. Deletion results in the removal of all personal data within 30 days, subject to legal retention obligations.

Werdhe may terminate an account without notice in the event of a serious violation of these Terms of Use.

12.contenu:
These Terms of Use are governed by Guinean law. Any dispute will be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Conakry, Guinea.

For any question about these terms, you can contact us at: contact@werdhe.com

seo.description: Werdhe's privacy policy — How we collect and protect your personal data.

confidentialite.intro: Protecting your personal data is a priority for Werdhe. This policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information.

1.contenu:
Personal data collected on Werdhe is processed by QbelyTech, publisher of the Werdhe platform, headquartered in Guinea.

Data controller contact: contact@werdhe.com

2.contenu:
Werdhe collects the following data:

Identification data:
• Last name, first name, email address
• Phone number (optional)
• Profile photo (Google OAuth)

Professional data (landlords):
• Information about properties
• Rental documents (leases, receipts)
• Transaction history

Application data (tenants):
• ID documents
• Proof of employment and income
• Guarantor's contact details

Technical data:
• IP address
• Connection logs
• Session cookies

3.contenu:
Your data is used to:
• Create and manage your user account
• Facilitate connections between landlords and tenants
• Generate contractual documents (leases, receipts)
• Process payments through our providers
• Send notifications and alerts related to your rental
• Improve our services and the user experience
• Comply with our legal obligations
• Combat fraud and illegal activity

4.contenu:
The processing of your data is based on:
• Performance of the contract: necessary to provide our services
• Your consent: for marketing communications
• Our legitimate interest: service improvement, security
• Legal obligation: retention of accounting documents

5.contenu:
Your data is retained for the following periods:
• Account data: lifetime of the account + 30 days after deletion
• Rental documents: 5 years after the end of the lease (legal obligation)
• Access logs: 90 days
• Payment data: 10 years (accounting obligation)
• Cookies: 13 months maximum

After these periods, your data is deleted or anonymized.

6.contenu:
Your data may be shared with:

Service providers:
• Supabase (database hosting) — USA
• Cloudinary (file storage) — USA
• Resend (email delivery) — USA
• Vercel (frontend hosting) — USA
• Render (backend hosting) — USA
• Orange Money / MTN MoMo (payments) — Guinea

These providers are contractually required to protect your data.

Werdhe never sells your data to third parties for commercial purposes.

Authorities: In the event of a legal obligation or court order.

7.contenu:
Werdhe implements the following security measures:
• Data encryption in transit (HTTPS/TLS)
• Password hashing (bcrypt)
• Two-factor authentication for admin accounts
• JWT tokens with expiration
• Audit logs for sensitive actions
• Rate limiting to prevent attacks
• Role-based access restriction to data

8.contenu:
In accordance with applicable regulations, you have the following rights:

• Right of access: obtain a copy of your personal data
• Right to rectification: correct inaccurate data
• Right to erasure: delete your data (subject to legal obligations)
• Right to portability: receive your data in a readable format
• Right to object: object to certain processing
• Right to restriction: limit the processing of your data

To exercise these rights, contact us at: contact@werdhe.com

We will respond to your request within 30 days.

9.contenu:
Werdhe uses the following cookies:

Essential cookies (cannot be disabled):
• Authentication token (user session)
• Language preferences
• Dark/light mode

Functional cookies:
• Remembering search filters
• Last tab visited

Werdhe does not use advertising or third-party tracking cookies.

10.contenu: Some of our providers (Supabase, Cloudinary, Vercel) are based in the United States. These transfers are governed by standard contractual clauses that guarantee an adequate level of protection for your data.

11.contenu: This privacy policy may be updated. In the event of a substantial change, you will be notified by email or by a notification on the platform at least 30 days before the changes take effect.

12.contenu:
For any question about this policy or to exercise your rights:

Email: contact@werdhe.com
Address: QbelyTech, Conakry, Guinea

If you believe your rights are not being respected, you may file a complaint with the competent data protection authorities in Guinea.
